_note: DEFENSE, REMOTE: the data recovery. Written by Jessica 2026-10-14 on his 'make them unique', over Eliza's
remote copy of 09a. Structure unchanged: pickup, deliver, hold (defend the deliver beat), no message boxes.
Waves are ELIZA'S PLACEHOLDER escalation. What is new: the thing you hold is a download, not a machine
aligning, and the client is off-world, which is the remote fiction: they cannot reach the files until the
terminal has power, and then they copy them across themselves while you keep people off it.
MODELS NOT ON THE APPROVED LIST, his eye first: Power_Cell_Static_PackinOnly (vanilla, STANDS, 0.57 m, small
on the ground) as the spare cell; MobileTerminal_01 (vanilla wheeled field terminal, STANDS, 1.5 m; Kim's
pick for 05a's console) as the research terminal. Both measured with gen_inspect bounds 2026-10-14.

prose.name: Defense: Data Recovery on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A research team pulled out of the <Place> and left their data behind. The terminal still has it, but it has no power, and copying it off will take time.

beats.objective: Find a power cell for the terminal at the <Place>
beats.name: Spare Power Cell

beats.journal: The terminal is powered and the team is copying their files off-world. Something will have noticed. I need to hold until the copy finishes.
beats.name: Research Terminal
say: We've got a connection. Copying now. Keep anything off it.

beats.journal: I powered the research terminal at the <Place> and held it while the team copied their data off-world. They have all of it.
say: That's all of it. Three years of work, and it's safe.

broadcast: We had to leave our data behind. The terminal still has it. It just needs power. The copy's slow, and you won't be alone out there long. Get it running and keep it running until we've copied everything.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, no places. Voice was ElevenLabs' 'Alice, Clear, Engaging Educator'; his ear 2026-10-27: "Elevenlabs voice sounds like a phone system instead of a person". Recast to Annie K, heard in game on 32a without complaint (voices.md).
